case_name: Navya & Others vs State Of H.P. & Others

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Three minor children, mother-natural guardian (Sh. Balwinder Singh and Smt. Neeraj Bala)

facts_of_case: Three minor children seek direction to enter their names in Panchayat record i.e Birth Register and Pariwar Register.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the person required to register births and deaths to give information to the Registrar within the prescribed time.
legal_principles.held: It shall be the duty of the persons specified below to give or cause to be given, either orally or in writing with signature, according to the best of their knowledge and belief, within such time as may be prescribed, information to the Registrar...

legal_principles.principle: The head of the household or the person recognized by the house is responsible for registering births and deaths in a residential or non-residential place.
legal_principles.held: in respect of births and deaths in a house, whether residential or non-residential, not being any place referred to in clauses (b) to (e), the head of the house or, in case more than one household live in the house, the head of the household...

outcome.final_order: Direction to the respondents to enter the name of the petitioners in the Birth Register and Pariwar Register.

use_for_drafting: drafting a writ petition for minor children's registration in Panchayat records
seeking directions from the court for registration of minor children
